mapper.select: select n.id, n.record_id, r.method, r.category, r.question, r.cast_at as castAt, n.nudge_date as nudgeDate from div_feedback_nudge n left join div_record r on r.id = n.record_id where n.user_id = #{userId} and n.status = 0 and n.is_delete = 0 order by n.nudge_date desc, n.id desc

select i.id as interpretation_id, i.record_id as record_id, i.user_id as user_id, date(i.created_at) + interval 3 day as nudge_date from div_interpretation i where i.created_at <= #{threshold} and not exists (select 1 from div_feedback f where f.interpretation_id = i.id) and not exists (select 1 from div_feedback_nudge n where n.interpretation_id = i.id)
